title: mri_gtmseg
description: Creates a segmentation that can be used with the geometric transfer matrix (GTM).

subseg_wm.description: Turn on segmenting of WM into smaller parts (off by default)
subseg_wm.title: Subsegment White Matter Flag

wm_annotation.description: Use annotation to subsegment white matter
wm_annotation.title: White Matter Annotation

dmax.description: Distance from cortex for white matter segmentation to be considered 'unsegmented' (default 5.000000)
dmax.title: Dmax

keep_hypo.description: Do not convert white matter hypointensities to a white matter label
keep_hypo.title: Keep Hypointensities Flag

keep_cc.description: Do not convert corpus callosum to a white matter label
keep_cc.title: Keep Corpus Callosum Flag

ctab.description: Copy items in ctab.lut into master ctab merging or overwriting what is there
ctab.title: CTAB Lookup Table

lhminmax.description: For defining left hemisphere ribbon in APAS (default: 1000 1900)
lhminmax.title: LH Min Max

rhminmax.description: For defining right hemisphere ribbon in APAS (default: 2000 2900)
rhminmax.title: RH Min Max

output_usf.description: Set actual output resolution. Default is to be the same as the --internal-usf
output_usf.title: Output Upsampling Factor

threads_max.description: Use the maximum allowable number of threads for this computer
threads_max.title: Max Threads Flag

threads_max_1.description: Use one less than the maximum allowable number of threads for this computer
threads_max_1.title: Max Threads Minus One Flag

check_opts.description: Don't run anything, just check options and exit
check_opts.title: Check Options Flag
